name: fleet_beacon
comment: test_*.cpp are HOST tests (each has its own main()) and must never be
linked into firmware. This directory is flat — headers and tests side by
side — so the exclusion is explicit here, where common/csi gets the same
effect for free by keeping sources under srcDir 'src'.
Without it, any project whose LDF discovers this library compiles all
three tests and the link dies on 'multiple definition of main'. That is
not hypothetical: it is what happened the moment canary-display first
included fleet_link/fleet_beacon_udp.h for the LAN-multicast band.
